review.summary: Round 3 reviews the whole TASK-069H branch, focusing on the test commit after round 2. Since round 2, the only change outside the review records is one new MCP tool test. It reads a timeserie over bounds that include a soft-deleted value and checks that the value is left out of both the returned page and value_count. The test fails when the count query drops the soft-delete filter, and when the page query does. Ruff check and pyright pass, and the full backend suite passes (1070 passed, 61 skipped). Review-001 F-001 stays an accepted risk for human confirmation: list_timeseries with include_values=true still reads every value of the scenario before cutting the response. No new findings.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: A new test reads the revenue timeserie over bounds that include its soft-deleted value. It asserts that only the four active values are returned, that value_count is 4 and that nothing is truncated. A mutation that drops the soft-delete filter from the count query, while keeping the timeserie and date conditions, fails only this test. The same is true when the filter is dropped from the page query.
